attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Russian, Romanian and Serbian rows already carry, and the entry is the same three: «Οι Άγιοι Τιμόθεος, Αγάπιος και Θέκλα, μαρτύρησαν στην Γάζα», under the eparch Ourbanos — Timothy burned, Agapius and Thecla thrown to the wild beasts. saint.gr gives no year, so no `dates` object is proposed here and the folders keep what they already have. The page's distich for Thecla names a homeland the other sources do not, «Ἔμοιγε κλῆσις Θέκλα· πατρὶς Βιζύη» — my name is Thecla, my homeland Bizye — which is recorded in the life and not in a `locations` entry, a distich being a verse and not a gazetteer. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no hymn, only the three distichs.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 01.09.2026 (19. август ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Тимотеј, Агапије и Текла.“
